_about: English plural forms for String Catalog keys. scripts/sync_strings.sh applies them after every build, so a literal like "\(n) minutes" reads "1 minute". A key with one number: {"one", "other"}. A key with several: {"value", "substitutions": {name: {"argNum", "one", "other"}}}, where %#@name@ marks the plural word and the other arguments are numbered (%1$lld). Translators add their own languages' forms in the catalog.

%lld topics have no material yet. Add so.one: %lld topic has no material yet. Add some and it joins your sessions.
%lld topics have no material yet. Add so.other: %lld topics have no material yet. Add some and they join your sessions.

Example reminder: %lld minutes tonight a.one: Example reminder: %lld minute tonight and you're done.
Example reminder: %lld minutes tonight a.other: Example reminder: %lld minutes tonight and you're done.

for %lld days, one time. Doesn't renew..other: for %lld days, one time. Doesn't renew.
